cues: Three kinds of fibre run through the matrix.
White collagen fibres: thick, wavy bundles, very strong and inelastic; boil them and they become gelatin.
Yellow elastic fibres: thin, branching, stretching to one and a half times their length and snapping back.
And fine reticular fibres, the mesh of lymph nodes and the spleen.
